verdict.rationale: Working Copy's manual documents a built-in Commit Graph, reached from the Repository screen, for exploring repository changes across branches, which matches the story directly. The evidence is a single brief first-party mention, with no detail on how the graph renders or behaves and no hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the graph's visualization (merges, branch lanes, filtering, scale on large histories) and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can visualize the full commit graph across branches

citations.quote: To explore repository changes across branches use the Commit Graph available from the Repository screen.
